# FINXIA Capital

> FINXIA Capital SCSp is a Luxembourg alternative investment vehicle, AI-native in its operations, deploying capital across four poles: TITAN DC AI (datacenter infrastructure), Premium Hospitality, Urban Residential & Flex Living, and C.CAPITAL (selective late-stage and secondaries). No fund-size figure is published. Content is informational and is not an offer of securities or investment advice.

## Strategies

- [TITAN DC AI](https://finxiacapital.com/strategies/): Brown-to-green transformation of underutilized European datacenter campuses for AI workloads (France, Spain, Italy primary markets).
- [Premium Hospitality](https://finxiacapital.com/strategies/): 4-5 star European hotels, operational repositioning with international operators.
- [Urban Residential & Flex Living](https://finxiacapital.com/strategies/): Coliving, build-to-rent, PBSA, senior living in major European cities.
- [C.CAPITAL](https://finxiacapital.com/strategies/): Ultra-selective late-stage, secondaries and special situations; conversion rate below 5%, tickets EUR 2-10M. Discount levels cited are a thesis target, not a market observation.
